name: codex-pager-plugin
description: Bridge a private T-Lora Pager room to an exact visible Codex Desktop task.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to an exact Codex Desktop task over private MeshCore.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local bridge and macOS Accessibility companion between the T-Lora Pager CODEX room, the Home Rig MeshCore gateway, and one explicitly configured visible Codex Desktop task.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the Codex T-Lora Pager bridge status and explain any problem without changing live services.
